title: The Beginning
voice_note: Voice-ready. Record each line as audio/voice/<line_id>.ogg (or .wav). If a file exists it plays automatically and the subtitle waits for it.

ch1_vo_001.speaker: HERO_VO
ch1_vo_001.text: They say you can't remember the day you were born. But I've heard the story so many times, I feel like I can.

ch1_001.speaker: MUM
ch1_001.text: Look at him. He's already holding on to my finger.

ch1_002.speaker: DAD
ch1_002.text: Strong grip. He's going to build things with those hands.

ch1_003.speaker: MUM
ch1_003.text: Welcome to the world, {HERO}. We have been waiting for you.

ch1_004.speaker: DAD
ch1_004.text: I promise you, son — as long as I'm alive, you will always have a home.
ch1_004.direction: serious, emotional. THEME LINE — echoed in the final chapter

ch1_005.speaker: GRANDMA
ch1_005.text: Bring him here! Let me see him. Ah — he has his father's forehead.

ch1_006.speaker: UNCLE
ch1_006.text: And his mother's stubbornness, I hope. Somebody in this family should have sense.

ch1_007.speaker: MUM
ch1_007.text: Femi! Everybody squeeze in. Photo — before he starts crying.

ch1_vo_002.speaker: HERO_VO
ch1_vo_002.text: Five years later, I was the most important person in that house. At least, that's what I believed.

ch1_010.speaker: MUM
ch1_010.text: There's my birthday boy! Five years old today. Come here, let me look at you.

ch1_011.speaker: HERO
ch1_011.text: Is that my cake? Can I taste it?

ch1_012.speaker: MUM
ch1_012.text: Not a single finger until tonight. Go and rescue your father — he's been fighting Grandma's old radio all morning.

ch1_013.speaker: MUM
ch1_013.text: Go on. If anybody can fix it, it's you.

ch1_020.speaker: DAD
ch1_020.text: Ah, the engineer has arrived. This radio hasn't played a song since you were born.

ch1_022.speaker: DAD
ch1_022.text: Maybe. Or maybe it's missing a battery, the tuning knob and my screwdriver. Help me find them, {NICK}?

ch1_023.speaker: DAD
ch1_023.text: Still missing a few pieces. Check the kitchen, your toy chest, and the shed.

ch1_024.speaker: DAD
ch1_024.text: You found everything? Alright, Mister Engineer. Show me how it's done.

ch1_025.speaker: DAD
ch1_025.text: You hear that? You did it! Your grandmother is going to cry.

ch1_026.speaker: MUM
ch1_026.text: Is that music? After five years? Who fixed it?

ch1_028.speaker: DAD
ch1_028.text: Yes you are. Now go — {SISTER} has been hiding from you for twenty minutes. She thinks she's winning.

ch1_030.speaker: HERO
ch1_030.text: Just socks. And Dad's old shoes. Pew.

ch1_033.speaker: SISTER
ch1_033.text: Nooo! How did you find me so fast? You're cheating!

ch1_034.speaker: HERO
ch1_034.text: I'm not cheating. I'm just smart.

ch1_035.speaker: SISTER
ch1_035.text: Fine. Birthday boy wins. Come on — Mum says it's time for cake!

ch1_040.speaker: ALL
ch1_040.text: ♪ Happy birthday, dear {HERO}... happy birthday to you! ♪
ch1_040.direction: family singing, a little out of tune

ch1_041.speaker: MUM
ch1_041.text: Make a wish, my love. A big one.

ch1_042.speaker: GRANDMA
ch1_042.text: So? What did you wish for?

ch1_043.speaker: HERO
ch1_043.text: That we all live together forever. In a big house. On an island!

ch1_044.speaker: UNCLE
ch1_044.text: An island! Then you'll have to build it yourself, small man.

ch1_046.speaker: DAD
ch1_046.text: We'll hold you to that. Everybody — photo!

ch1_vo_010.speaker: HERO_VO
ch1_vo_010.text: Every year, the house got a little smaller. Or maybe I just got bigger.

ch1_vo_011.speaker: HERO_VO
ch1_vo_011.text: The radio came apart and went back together a hundred times. So did I.

ch1_vo_012.speaker: HERO_VO
ch1_vo_012.text: But I never forgot what I promised them.

mem_newborn_photo.speaker: HERO_VO
mem_newborn_photo.text: The first family photo. Uncle Femi blinked. He always blinks.

mem_wedding.speaker: HERO_VO
mem_wedding.text: Mum and Dad, before me. Dad swears he wasn't nervous. His hands say otherwise.

mem_drawing.speaker: HERO_VO
mem_drawing.text: My first blueprint: a robot with a heart. Mum kept it on the fridge for years.

mem_height.speaker: HERO_VO
mem_height.text: Every birthday, Dad marked my height on this door frame. I used to stand on my toes.

mem_toy_robot.speaker: HERO_VO
mem_toy_robot.text: Bolt. A wind-up robot with one wobbly leg. I took him apart before I could read.
mem_toy_robot.direction: sets up the robot companion in Chapter 2

mem_treehouse.speaker: HERO_VO
mem_treehouse.text: Keep Out — except Mum. My first property. I've always wanted a place of my own.
